author: Raguvers
quote: Waited 13 years for this, and it is nothing short of a massive disappointment. Instead of delivering the raw, unapologetic satire that made the franchise legendary, Rockstar caved in and turned GTA VI into a sanitized, woke mess. Just look at the backlash all over Twitter right now—real fans are furious, and the 99 critic score is completely disconnected from reality. Easily the biggest letdown in gaming history.
